name: Libration Mirror Shoals
core_rationale: Western oscillating tide-mirror shoals of Continent 03 where Vesper's lunar libration rocks shallow silver-water atolls in a slow twelve-hour tilt.
local_conflict: Mirror-shell crabs and reflection-wisps guard the tilting star-glass tide pools.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Cartographers say that when Libration Mirror Shoals tilts toward the twilight horizon, a dry causeway of silver coral rises out of the mirror-pools.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Stepped basalt atolls holding sheet-silver tide pools that tilt in unison like a giant balance scale.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What sunken observatory dome emerges only when Libration Mirror Shoals reaches maximum western tilt?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the western libration rim of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Tilting basalt atolls whose sheet-silver tide pools reflect ancient pre-war constellations.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m silver-coral causeways, 0.58m tide-gauge benches, and 0.14m basalt risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Silver-Tide Causeway and Libration Balance Haven.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-silver-tide-causeway as a Mystery frontier.
